chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, and Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, and a number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, all from Ibn Mahboub, from Malik ibn Atiyya, from Suleiman, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The slanderer of the woman cursed by her husband (in the context of li'an) is whipped.
ai.seo_question: What is the punishment for a slanderer in the context of li'an according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies that the hadd penalty of flogging applies specifically to the qadhf (slanderer) within the framework of li'an, distinguishing it from general slander cases. It reflects the Shia juristic emphasis on the procedural integrity of the husband-wife mutual cursing ritual as a distinct legal category for establishing guilt and assigning punishment.
